content.short: Layerswap enables fast and reliable cross-chain transfers across networks and exchanges.
content.description: Layerswap provides fast transfers of crypto assets across blockchains and centralized exchanges. It enables cross-chain transfers between 35+ chains and direct transfers between networks and 15+ centralized exchanges.
content.meta: Layerswap enables fast, cross-chain crypto transfers across blockchains and exchanges. Discover Layerswap and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
